subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: The history arm shall declare itself base-requiring (the "needs a history base" applicability flag), and while no merge base is present the gate shall skip it.
rationale: history checks need a merge base; the pre-commit/desk path has none (F-3, F-4, P-1); this mirrors `check-immutable` exactly
fit_criterion: with no merge base, the gate runs but the history arm does not; with a base present it runs — the base-free path's verdict excludes the history arm, matching `check-immutable`'s degradation
